location.climate: Four seasons, cold winters (-3°C to 5°C), hot humid summers (25-32°C)

required_documents.notes: Columbia-specific essays including famous list questions

unique_programs: 3-2 Engineering program with liberal arts colleges
Dual BA with Sciences Po and other international universities

korean_student_specific.korean_food_access: Excellent - Koreatown Manhattan (30 min), Flushing (40 min), many Korean restaurants near campus
korean_student_specific.korean_church_proximity: Multiple Korean churches in Manhattan and Queens

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: Urban sophisticates, globally-minded students, strong writers with Core Curriculum fit

korean_specific_advice: Show genuine interest in Columbia's Core Curriculum - it's central to identity
The list essays should reveal personality - be creative and specific
NYC is a resource - demonstrate how you'll use the city
Strong humanities foundation valued alongside any major
ED rate much higher than RD - consider ED if Columbia is top choice
Global perspective and multicultural engagement valued highly
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Not showing genuine interest in the Core Curriculum
List essays too generic or playing it safe
Not demonstrating why NYC location matters to you
Failing to show intellectual engagement with ideas
Essays too similar to other Ivy applications

campus_life.dining_options: Multiple dining halls, JJ's Place, NYC restaurants
campus_life.safety_rating: Good - Columbia Public Safety, well-lit campus
campus_life.nearby_attractions: All of NYC, Central Park, Broadway, Museums, Brooklyn

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Very strong Columbia Korean Alumni Association, especially in finance
